title: Debiasing Multilingual LLMs in Cross-lingual Latent Space
findings: The paper's primary finding is methodological: applying debiasing techniques (INLP and SentDebias) in a learned cross-lingual latent space significantly reduces religious bias scores and improves the cross-lingual transferability of the debiasing, compared to applying the same techniques in the model's original representation space. This was demonstrated across English, French, German, and Dutch for the Aya-expanse-8B and Llama3.1-8B-Instruct models.
